1011vc-anchorage-digital:lever:34610fea-.description: At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto. Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings. The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. Skills required include professional communication, negotiation, creative thinking and problem solving. In addition to managing your portfolio of clients, you will also be involved in helping to drive the broader sales efforts around our stablecoin issuance and cross border settlement strategy. We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced regional financial institution sales representative to join our team, and drive new business from institutional clients active in the digital asset industry, particularly the stablecoins space. Must be based in New York City and available to come in-office.

a16z-jeeves:lever:e1f64ae7-253f-4670-93a.description: Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards. Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi). This role requires someone who is crypto-obsessed and deeply familiar with the stablecoin ecosystem: issuance and reserve models, on/off-ramp mechanics, fiat rail interoperability, and institutional adoption trends. We want someone who has built stablecoin or crypto payment products at a stablecoin issuer, crypto exchange, cross-border payment platform, or fintech building on blockchain rails. gaingels-xona-space-systems:ashbyhq:ed8b.description: Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience with satellite communications and GNSS. - Solid fundamentals in high-speed digital logic design and timing closure techniques. - Experience with lab validation, test automation, and hardware debugging tools - Experience in ARM-based MPSoC systems (Cortex-A/R), with experience developing Embedded Linux (PetaLinux/Yocto) and device drivers specifically for Zynq UltraScale+ environments. Key Competencies: - Strong foundation in both digital logic design and DSP with practical FPGA implementation expertise. - Execution-focused mindset with emphasis on timing closure and hardware validation. - Clear technical communication and documentation. - Ability to collaborate across systems, RF, software, and navigation teams to deliver flight-ready FPGA solutions For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR. greathillpartners-versapay:lever:e7b6697.title: Principal Product Manager, Payments
greathillpartners-versapay:lever:e7b6697.description: About Versapay 🚀 Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage. Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward. Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually. Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!! The Move Money Platform connects Versapay to the world’s financial systems. Every card authorization, financial event, and post-transaction action flows through our money movement platform. As a Principal Product Manager, you own the network strategy, design, connections, compliance, and ultimate performance of our network relationships. Our job is to build a platform that obscures the complexity, maximizes acceptance, and handles volume gracefully across a global network of fiat and crypto partners. Our work will optimize cost, efficiency, and enable rapid geographic expansion. The principal platform product manager owns the Move Money Platform end-to-end. This is a role with global scope and full ownership of platform and network strategy, roadmap development, and execution/ delivery. You will set our global network strategy, decide which rails we connect to and how, design the routing logic that handles each transaction, own resiliency and redundancy across providers, and represent Versapay externally with networks, sponsor banks, processors, custodians, on/off-ramp partners, and regulators. This role reports into the Payments product organization. It is structured for someone who has owned network products at a payments, processing, or fintech company and is energized by the operational and strategic depth of running a global money-movement platform spanning fiat and crypto rails.
responsibilities: Own the Move Money Platform roadmap, strategy, and execution globally . Set the multi-year vision for how Versapay connects to financial networks (fiat and crypto) across North America, EMEA, and expansion markets. Translate that vision into a durable roadmap with clear bets, sequencing, and measurable outcomes: auth rate, cost per transaction, settlement speed, uptime, and geographic coverage, etc...

Lead engineering teams through the full SDLC . Own product requirements, technical design partnership, sprint planning, and release readiness across the engineering pods that build and operate the platform. Drive trade-off decisions on architecture, throughput, latency, and resiliency in collaboration with engineering leadership, and stay accountable for shipping on commitment.

Design and operate our network connectivity across fiat and crypto . Design network connections, including which networks connect directly versus through processors, sponsor banks, custodians, or on/off-ramp partners..

Own redundancy, resiliency, and performance . Define our fault-tolerance posture across providers, rails, and chains. Eliminate single points of failure. Build automated failover and graceful degradation between fiat and crypto rails when conditions warrant.

Own compliance across networks, chains, and jurisdictions . Stay ahead of network compliance and operating rule adherence for fiat and crypto rails. Translate these into product requirements before they become audit findings.

Be Versapay’s external face to networks, partners, and regulators . Build and maintain trusted relationships with card networks, ACH and RTP operators, sponsor banks, processors, stablecoin issuers, custodians, on/off-ramp partners, etc.. Represent Versapay in scheme working groups, partner roadmap reviews, regulator-facing engagements.

Use AI to make the network smarter.  Apply modern AI capabilities to network operations across fiat and crypto: intelligent routing, decline recovery, on-chain anomaly detection, fraud and sanctions signal integration, settlement forecasting, and operational automation. Have a clear point of view on where AI improves a money-movement platform and where it should not be near it.

Be the in-house expert . Serve as Versapay’s authority on payment networks, money-movement mechanics, stablecoin and on-chain settlement, and global rail economics. Educate product, engineering, finance, and go-to-market teams. Brief executives. Influence the broader product roadmap with what you know about where the world’s payment infrastructure is going.
